blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 182 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 6, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & MRNA lead 182 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 34 Canadian and 148 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 6, 2026) found 182 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 34 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 22 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +96% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 6 names.

In the U.S., 148 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 91 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +387% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 40 names.
